tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && (find routes utils -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -print0 | /usr/bin/xargs -0 -n 50 deno check --unstable-kv) && deno check --unstable-kv fresh.config.ts fresh.gen.ts main.ts
tasks.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
tasks.start:full: deno run -A npm:concurrently@9.1.2 -k -n fresh,client "deno run -A --unstable-kv --watch=static/,routes/ dev.ts" "cd client && npm run dev"
